Content following a table whose last row is never closed is still converted

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><th>Before</th></tr><tr></table><p>Visible footer</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
